# Vaelspire — Open-Core Rust Identity & Auth Platform by Neotales

> Ultra-lightweight Rust identity & authentication platform: 11 MIT Open-Core embeddable crates (including Cloudflare D1 `vaelspire-store-d1` and reusable multi-sink `vaelspire-alerts`) + single-binary OIDC 1.0 IdP / Passkeys / Per-App RBAC / Self-Service Org SSO / SCIM 2.0 Users & Groups / GDPR / `/forward-auth` / embedded SvelteKit UI server + Cloudflare/Kubernetes deployments. Proprietary Enterprise modules live in a separate private repository (`neotales/vaelspire-enterprise`).
